news.t: Matthew Kessel Makes Islanders' Debut In 3-2 Win

posts.t: Kessel turnover but Hutton blocks the shot. #Isles

Anthony Duclair. 1-0 #Isles with 16:48 to go in the first. What a shift by fourth line/Hutotn-Kessel. 

Kessel skated down the right side and fed Duclair in the slot for a great look...and a great result. 

That might have been Kessel's best shift as an Islander.
